ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of ~$1.54 to the rider for the unexempted deviation km (capped by the actual metered overcharge), and remind the driver to stay on the shortest/most direct route or obtain passenger agreement before deviating.

segment_findings.reason: Driver's metered trace is 19.31 km vs 17.253 km quoted (2.057 km extra). Under RD-4(a) the portion replacing the incident stretch of the optimal route (Accident on Seletar Expressway at 1.39304,103.82779, on-route, reported 17:16 before the trip) is exempt, but the remainder of the deviation has no traffic incident supporting it; the applicable speed bands (4 and 5) exceed the band-2 threshold and under RD-4(b) cannot exempt on their own. No pre-departure passenger agreement exists in the chat, so RD-5 does not apply.

rejected_claims.reason: Only partially supported: the Seletar Expressway accident is verified by an LTA incident, but it justifies only the stretch that replaces the blocked portion of the optimal route (~2.0 km of the 2.06 km extra), not the entire deviation.
Speed bands on the relevant links are 4 (Seletar Expressway) and 5 (Tampines Expressway), neither ≤2, and RD-4(b) in any case cannot exempt on its own.
Driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so the repetition condition for flag_account is not met.
